title: loadCliProgram
responsibility: Builds the root Commander program and loads only the selected command family while keeping full root help available.

inputs.name: loadCliProgram.args
inputs.description: Arguments after the executable name; the first token selects a command, while `help <command>` selects the following token.

outputs.name: loadCliProgram
outputs.description: A configured Commander root program with the selected command family registered and other families represented by help placeholders.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A selected command family import or registration failure rejects the returned promise.
